summary: Iteration 8 - Full backend + frontend E2E validation of Memory Engineering (text-first) and Enterprise Evolution Governance (Extend Before Expand). All backend endpoints working; all frontend flows verified including the consumer memory-hook regression.
critical_code_review_comments: memory_engineering.manufacture_memory_job runs as an unbounded asyncio.create_task on the request event loop; if the process restarts mid-manufacture the KR stays stuck in 'manufacturing'. Consider a job queue / status timeout reaper.

Memory Engineering polling in MemoryEngineering.js uses setInterval(3000) with no clear-on-unmount safeguard beyond the finish states; leaving the page mid-manufacture leaks the interval and calls setState on an unmounted component.
